posts.title: €1M from Sovereign Tech Agency to Fuel Post-Quantum Readiness at Let's Encrypt
posts.description: Sovereign Tech Agency is investing in the development of a Merkle Tree Certificate Authority at Let’s Encrypt through the end of 2027 with a contract totaling more than €1M . This is the largest single investment in post-quantum readiness at Let’s Encrypt to date. This investment will help pave the path for free post-quantum Merkle Tree Certificates for people globally. posts.title: A Good Day for Cryptography
posts.description: October 16, 2026 was a good day for the cryptography community. A 25-year-old question about the math behind some of the Internet’s most widely used encryption was finally answered . The previously lost method used to create the widely-used NIST elliptic curves has been found. posts.title: 64-Day Certificate Lifetimes Coming Feb 2027
posts.description: On February 10, 2027, all Let’s Encrypt subscribers will move to certificates with 64 day lifetimes by default unless they select an even shorter lifetime (45 or 6 days, as previously announced ). This means that any certificate we issue or renew on and after that date will have a 64 day validity period, and we expect the last 90-day certificate to expire on May 11, 2027.
